title: Great App
body: Have to say It's been a long time I'm searching for this specific type of app and this one solves my issues. It's way more practical than having a bullet journal around. Thanks for it!
author: Giazcosmos

title: Life changer
body: This app has changed my life and the way that I tackle behaviour change in myself. Day by day you get there and this app does this in a seamless way across devices. Fantastic work!
author: Sbmt001
